extraction.Name: Charles Conoyer
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded January 26, 1921, by J. F. Frame
extraction.Buyer: Conoyer conveyed the land by deed to Edwin Fred Marquist for $3000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739670 issued; receipt signed by the allottee April 5, 1920; Northwest quarter section 12, township 95, north of range 78; conveyance dated April 1, 1926
